    static class Dijkstra {
        int N;
        List<List<int[]>> E;

        public Dijkstra(int n) {
            N = n;
            E = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                E.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        public void insert(int u, int v, int w) {
            E.get(u).add(new int[]{v, w});
        }

        public int[] dijkstra(int start, int end) {
            int[] dist = new int[N + 1];
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[start] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> b[0] - a[0]);
            pq.offer(new int[]{0, start});
            
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int w = -pq.peek()[0];
                int u = pq.poll()[1];
                if (u == end) return dist;
                if (dist[u] < w) continue;
                for (int[] edge : E.get(u)) {
                    int v = edge[0];
                    int w2 = w + edge[1];
                    if (dist[v] > w2) {
                        dist[v] = w2;
                        pq.offer(new int[]{-w2, v});
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist;
        }

        public void g() {

            int n = sc.nextInt();
            int e = sc.nextInt();
            Dijkstra dk = new Dijkstra(n);

            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if (ans[i] >= INF) System.out.println("INF");
                else System.out.println(ans[i]);
            }
        }
    }

    static class Palindrome {

            for (x = xx; x > 0; x /= 10) {
                v.add((int)(x % 10));
            }
            n = v.size();
            for (i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                if (v.get(i) != v.get(n - i - 1)) return 0;
            }
            return 1;
        }

    static class PrimeNumber {
        int N;
        List<Integer> NP, P;

        public PrimeNumber() {
        }

        public PrimeNumber(int n) {
            N = n;
            NP = new ArrayList<>();
            P = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= N + 3; i++) NP.add(0);
            for (int i = 2; i * i <= N; i++) {
                if (NP.get(i) != 0) continue;
                for (int j = i * i; j <= N; j += i) NP.set(i, 1);
            }
            for (int i = 2; i <= N; i++) {
                if (NP.get(i) == 0) P.add(i);
            }
        }

        public long gcd(long x, long y) {
            long z;
            while (x != 0) {
                z = y % x;
                y = x;
                x = z;
            }
            return y;
        }

        public long powermod(long p, long q) {
            long g = gcd(p, q);
            p /= g;
            q /= g;
            return p * powmod(q, MOD - 2) % MOD;
        }

        public List<Integer> factorization(int x) {
            List<Integer> ret = new ArrayList<>();
            int i;
            if (x == 1) {
                ret.add(1);
                return ret;
            }
            ret.add(1);
            ret.add(x);
            for (i = 2; i * i < x; i++) {
                if (x % i == 0) {
                    ret.add(i);
                    ret.add(x / i);
                }
            }
            if (i * i == x) ret.add(i);
            return ret;
        }

        public int factorization2(int x) {
            int ret = 0, i;
            if (x == 1) {
                return 1;
            }
            ret = 2;
            for (i = 2; i * i < x; i++) {
                if (x % i == 0) {
                    ret += 2;
                }
            }
            if (i * i == x) ret++;
            return ret;
        }

        private long powmod(long a, long b) {
            if (b == 0) return 1;
            if ((b & 1) == 1) return a * powmod(a, b - 1) % MOD;
            return powmod(a * a % MOD, b / 2);
        }
    }

        public void init(int n) {
            N = n;
            C = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
                C.add(new ArrayList<>());
                for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                    C.get(i).add(0L);
                }

                C.get(i).set(i, 1L);
                C.get(i).set(0, 1L);

            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                    C.get(i).set(j, (C.get(i - 1).get(j - 1) + C.get(i - 1).get(j)) % MOD);
                }
            }
            F = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) F.add(0L);
            F.set(0, 1L);
            F.set(1, 1L);
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                F.set(i, (F.get(i - 1) * i) % MOD);
            }
        }

        int[][] P;

        public SegmentTree2D(int n, int m) {
            N = n;
            M = m;
            P = new int[n + 1][m + 1];
            T = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n * m * 2; i++) T.add(new Point());

        public Point build(int node, int a1, int b1, int a2, int b2) {
            if (a1 > a2 || b1 > b2) return def();

            if (a1 == a2 && b1 == b2) {
                T.set(node, new Point(a1, b1, P[a1][b1]));
                return T.get(node);
            }

            T.set(node, def());
            T.set(node, maxNode(T.get(node), build(4 * node - 2, a1, b1, (a1 + a2) / 2, (b1 + b2) / 2)));
            T.set(node, maxNode(T.get(node), build(4 * node - 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, b1, a2, (b1 + b2) / 2)));
            T.set(node, maxNode(T.get(node), build(4 * node + 0, a1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2, b2)));
            T.set(node, maxNode(T.get(node), build(4 * node + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, a2, b2)));
            return T.get(node);
        }

        public Point query(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
            return _query(1, 1, 1, N, M, x1, y1, x2, y2);
        }

        public Point _query(int node, int a1, int b1, int a2, int b2, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
            if (x1 > a2 || y1 > b2 || x2 < a1 || y2 < b1 || a1 > a2 || b1 > b2) return def();

            if (x1 <= a1 && y1 <= b1 && a2 <= x2 && b2 <= y2) return T.get(node);

            Point mx = def();
            mx = maxNode(mx, _query(4 * node - 2, a1, b1, (a1 + a2) / 2, (b1 + b2) / 2, x1, y1, x2, y2));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _query(4 * node - 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, b1, a2, (b1 + b2) / 2, x1, y1, x2, y2));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _query(4 * node + 0, a1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2, b2, x1, y1, x2, y2));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _query(4 * node + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, a2, b2, x1, y1, x2, y2));

            return mx;
        }

        public Point _update(int node, int a1, int b1, int a2, int b2, int x, int y, int value) {
            if (a1 > a2 || b1 > b2) return def();

            if (x > a2 || y > b2 || x < a1 || y < b1) return T.get(node);

            if (x == a1 && y == b1 && x == a2 && y == b2) {
                T.set(node, new Point(x, y, value));
                return T.get(node);
            }

            Point mx = def();
            mx = maxNode(mx, _update(4 * node - 2, a1, b1, (a1 + a2) / 2, (b1 + b2) / 2, x, y, value));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _update(4 * node - 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, b1, a2, (b1 + b2) / 2, x, y, value));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _update(4 * node + 0, a1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2, b2, x, y, value));
            mx = maxNode(mx, _update(4 * node + 1, (a1 + a2) / 2 + 1, (b1 + b2) / 2 + 1, a2, b2, x, y, value));
            T.set(node, mx);

        }
